name: On the Q.T.
source:
Ema has worked really hard to achieve her goal of becoming a singer. After debuting as a member of the eight-member idol unit "Lu-ce", she achieved success and renown as a tremendously popular idol. Yet in a group known best for perfectly synchronized dance sequences, it wasn't possible to shine through with her singing.

Ema had lost sight of her original goal and was losing interest in show business, but after coming into contact with the popular idol group "Un:Finish", her life began to take a new turn.

translation:
惠麻为成为歌手努力奋斗。作为八人偶像组合Lu-ce成员出道后，她取得了成功，成为极受欢迎的偶像。然而，在以舞蹈动作完美同步而闻名的组合中，她不可能凭歌声脱颖而出。

惠麻逐渐忘记最初的目标，对演艺事业也失去兴趣。但在接触热门偶像组合“Un:Finish”后，她的人生开始迎来新的转折。
